data.name: Victoria
data.gender_notes: Victoria is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin victoria, 'victory'. Its root is Latin victoria. A Christian name; borne by Saint Victoria. Victoria is a Latin name meaning “Victory”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Victoria expresses “Victory”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Victoria total 43, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
